title: Induced-Minor-Closed Classes have Linear, Square-Root, or Sub-Polynomial Tree-Independence
summary: An independent set in a graph $G$ is a set of pairwise non-adjacent vertices. A tree decomposition of $G$ is a pair $(T, χ)$ where $T$ is a tree and $χ: V(T) \rightarrow 2^{V(G)}$ is a function satisfying two axioms: for every edge $uv \in E(G)$ there is an $x \in V(T)$ such that $\{u,v\} \subseteq χ(x)$, and for every vertex $u \in V(G)$ the set $\{x \in V(T) | u \in χ(x)\}$ induces a non-empty and connected subtree of $T$.
